title: Cascading Water Over Forest Dam Spillway, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A wide, horizontal snapshot capturing water cascading evenly across the wide crest of a weir or low-head dam spillway. Below the cascade, churning foam flows around flat, layered rock ledges and boulders. Behind the concrete structure lies a calm, glassy millpond or reservoir reflecting the sky, flanked by a dense line of pine and hardwood forest along the distant shoreline. Printed on classic deckle-edged paper typical of mid-20th-century amateur American travel and outdoor leisure photography.
